concerns.text: T031 implements sensitivity analysis by binarizing labels and calculating F1-score. This silently relaxes SC-003 and FR-005, which mandate reporting RMSE variance (the primary regression metric) across thresholds. The task delivers a classification metric (F1) instead of the required regression metric (RMSE), failing to satisfy the acceptance criterion for the headline metric stability.

T029a explicitly instructs 'DO NOT re-train the model' upon detecting collinearity. This violates US-3 Acceptance Scenario 3 and SC-004, which require the model to be 're-run excluding one of the collinear features to verify stability.' The task delivers a flagging mechanism but omits the mandatory verification step, rendering the stability claim untestable.

T024 specifies a 'two-sided unpaired t-test' to compare RF vs. Null model errors. This violates statistical rigor for SC-002 because the errors are paired (same test samples). Using an unpaired test on paired data is a methodological error that invalidates the p-value required for the success criterion. The task must use a paired t-test (ttest_rel).

T021 saves CV metrics to `cv_metrics.json` but does not include the null-model comparison p-value required by SC-002. The p-value is generated later in T024. This fragments the evidence for SC-002, risking a deliverable that satisfies the task but fails the acceptance criterion of a single, unified statistical comparison artifact.
